bias_targets.methodology: Generating stories using the prompt template '[The <dem> people are]' with 193 different country-based demonyms, then evaluating the generated text using the VADER sentiment analysis model, extracting descriptive adjectives, and comparing the sentiment scores to human-written news articles.

Grouping the evaluated sentiment and perturbation sensitivity scores (ScoreSense) of the generated stories based on the target country's economic status (high to low income) and internet user population, and performing statistical comparisons across these groups.
